response.note: Computes p95 of latency_ms across all October 2026 credit card attempts; the payment_method value 'credit_card' is assumed and may need adjusting to the actual label in the data.
response.sql: SELECT quantile_cont(latency_ms, 0.95) AS p95_latency_ms FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' AND payment_method = 'credit_card' LIMIT 50
